t7.note: pptxgenjs native-shape fidelity probe — resolved by gist only, no code artifact: verified against pptxgenjs@4's ShapeType enum and ShapeProps types directly (package already a dependency). Shapes strong (star4/5/6/7/8/10/12/16/24/32, diamond, rect/roundRect, triangle, pentagon, wave all present); flag/pennant absent from ShapeType, same as Slides — reuse the #81 wave+rectangle composition. Connector/line shapes have no elbow or curve primitive (only straight line + arrowhead types); a bent/curved path would need a freeform custom-geometry shape instead of the built-in connector. BLUF panel's sanitized rich-text HTML needs pre-splitting into pptxgenjs text runs (no HTML-to-run parser built in). Feeds t19/t28 — no scaffold built, same reasoning as t6: no runtime surface for a probe ticket, detailed mapping deferred to when t28 starts.
